verdict.rationale: Unleash documents metric-driven automation. Impact metrics can automatically advance rollout milestones or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when thresholds are crossed. Scheduled releases and release templates add time-based and predefined rollout sequences. The automation is limited to rollout and release management, though, not a general event-to-action rule engine. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule builder for arbitrary events and actions, outbound actions or webhooks triggered by events, in-depth configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
